risks.risk: Default import or runtime still resolves the retired archive or an external checkout.
risks.evidence: Deep doctor, direct import, CLI, package resource, clean workspace, wheel, and detached release all resolve embedded source; archive and external-source counts are zero.

risks.risk: Release silently retains a LoopX wheel/tar install path.
risks.evidence: Tracked archive count and legacy asset count are zero. Release inventory and cleanroom first task require neither LoopX archive installation nor extraction.

risks.risk: v0.2.13 changes private state, idempotency, single-writer, or control semantics.
risks.evidence: A P2-S01-03 workspace with real goal/todo/claim/quota/history/interaction/outbox/cursor state survives two independent target restarts with the same semantic digest and no duplicate side effect.

risks.risk: Upgrade silently resets state or transfers lease/budget ownership.
risks.evidence: Cursor remains 3, quota spend remains 1, claim remains private, canonical mutation count remains 3, claim is not a worker lease, and quota is not an execution budget.

risks.risk: The complete source exists only as dead package content.
risks.evidence: API /loopx-connect reaches the embedded runtime in a detached first task. Probe, API, runtime, CLI, extension, skill, template, and package-resource provenance is verified.
Windows and Ubuntu 22.04 WSL produce the same 1,925-file tree digest, manifest SHA-256, package lock digest, and source identities after explicit LF materialization.

review_discoveries.discovery: No reusable two-checkout upgrade harness existed after the implementation commit.
review_discoveries.resolution: Added an independent-process baseline-to-target upgrade gate.

review_discoveries.discovery: Host line-ending conversion made Windows and WSL archive bytes diverge.
review_discoveries.resolution: Canonicalized Git materialization and repository line endings.

review_discoveries.discovery: The previous cleanroom verified resolver and doctor but did not execute an actual first task.
review_discoveries.resolution: Added a task-creation and /loopx-connect cleanroom probe; its first run also found and eliminated a user-home Bun cache write.

review_discoveries.discovery: Wheel-only API execution could not prove the TypeScript runtime source that belongs to the full release payload.
review_discoveries.resolution: Bound first-task API and package imports to the full verified payload and required all origins to remain beneath it.

review_discoveries.discovery: The first-task provenance re-check used cleanroom cwd instead of the verified payload root.
review_discoveries.resolution: Made package-root custody explicit at the probe boundary.
